title: Bit construction: exact five-wire windows reduce composed R439 to 10,492 ADDs
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

On the frozen PR1122 composed R439 word, 59 disjoint five-wire A replacements save **160 ADDs including literal cleanup: 10,652 → 10,492**. A complete GL(5,2) distance certificate and interval lower bound prove that 160 is the maximum saving within the declared one-pass domain: disjoint original same-frame windows, exactly five labelled wires, at most 12 old ADDs, no auxiliaries, fixed remaining sections and literal reverse cleanup.

Nine selected replacements require more than six ADDs. The same nominees restricted to length ≤6 save only 144 complete ADDs, so removing that ceiling contributes 16 further savings in that controlled comparison. This does not replay PR936's different source, guards or path selection.

Forward/reverse positive bounds improve to 13,667 / 3,758,418; sufficient local/nine-stage widths are 91/175 bits, within unchanged 104/192-bit charges. All frame paths, copies, paid histogram and rank mass agree. **Finite construction; no new κ or supplier adoption.** The inherited semantic-D H2/K-equals-D failures remain explicit. All-size/compiler, common-label, hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain.

## Task and overlap

Seed 13 bit assignment; task card is `research/r439-gl5-shortest/CLAIM.json`. Base `c0e3631dc24e3c24a861f7d3d79e0608481cccec`; exact PR1122 input `a2551e70fce0cc34348f50f1a94e7cc4c80bbcbf`. Fresh overlap through PR1178 and upstream `1b59b624d21924f8e3537cdc1ac52d3be6eda2fe`: all 15 base pins unchanged; selected PR1094/PR589 unchanged. PR1127's commuting Steinberg system is distinct. Only the new research package is added.

Optimal CNOT/GL5 BFS is established prior work, credited in the README. The contribution is the pinned application, exact bounded optimum and complete physical/precision admission.

## Validation

```sh
BOOST_INCLUDE=/path/to/boost-headers python3 -I -B research/r439-gl5-shortest/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/r439-gl5-shortest/test_package.py
```

- Independent certificate check: 9,999,360 vertices and 199,987,200 directed edges; all 1,203 windows/986 maps; 38,496 Boolean input cases; independent interval optimum and 59 full admission trials.
- Two full words in both directions on 661 dirty formal columns; unchanged native 5/9/11-stage legality/column checks; 20 local controls and 96 omitted-bridge controls reject.
- 10 package tests and 14 selected-record/finite-bit-contract tests pass. 21 source Git pins verified. Full canonical receipt identical on 3.14.4 normal and a read-only relocated 3.12.3 isolated optimized run: `651157b0fecd64d805ef3b871435b2891ebce14a1118af55d35cd42a41b987f0`.

No selected hosted cold replay was run because the selected construction and its sources are unchanged. Hosted PR CI is separate from these completed local checks.
